description: Google Gemini Function Calling Schema for CRETA MEDIA Virtual Studio & WhatsApp Integration

functionDeclarations.name: creta_get_departments
functionDeclarations.description: Returns all 6 photorealistic departments in the CRETA MEDIA virtual production studio (Exterior, Reception, Dubbing, Editing, Film Set, Social Hub) along with active statuses.

functionDeclarations.name: creta_navigate_department
functionDeclarations.description: Navigates the 3D virtual studio tour to a specific department (0=Exterior, 1=Reception, 2=Dubbing, 3=Editing, 4=FilmSet, 5=SocialHub).

functionDeclarations.name: creta_send_whatsapp
functionDeclarations.description: Sends a direct WhatsApp message to any phone number without needing any passwords. Uses the scanned WhatsApp session.

to.description: Recipient phone number with country code, e.g. '919068734941'

message.description: The WhatsApp message content to send

functionDeclarations.name: creta_request_dubbing
functionDeclarations.description: Requests voice recording and dubbing in 70+ languages with Neumann U87 and SSL console specs.

functionDeclarations.name: creta_request_video_editing
functionDeclarations.description: Submits a 4K DaVinci Resolve grading and editing task in 16:9 or 9:16.

functionDeclarations.name: creta_request_microdrama
functionDeclarations.description: Commissions an original vertical mobile microdrama series.
